integrity: A reproducible exact finite type recursion and its output are provided. Self-review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact result is for nonempty finite strict betweenness chains at quantifier rank four, not arbitrary ternary betweenness relations or higher ranks. The finite computation is exhaustive only for orders of size at most 15; all larger sizes use the proved classical ordered-chain EF bound. Unindexed literature may contain equivalent claims.
title: Fourteen rank-four theories of finite strict-betweenness chains
